title: Finite ringed coordinates and proper/open scalar factorization
statement: Use the ringed coefficient families and scalar-adjunction comparison of [def-strict-coefficient-ringed-geometric-data]. For every change $a:R\to S$, the compact-support comparison for $f=pj$ factors as the proper scalar mate after $j_R$, followed by $Rp_{S,*}$ applied to the open scalar mate [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. At positive finite coefficients, the ringed ordinary direct image equals the constant-ring direct image [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]; ringed open extension is identified with intrinsic extension by zero by uniqueness of its left adjunction [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. Whiskering these two identifications gives finiteImageIso. The completed-to-finite derived scalar extension is identified with the recorded scalarReductionDerivedExtension by finiteReductionIso [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. These are presentation identifications and a mate-pasting identity on all ambient objects, with no constructibility or comparison-isomorphism assertion.

proof.text: All declarations are already proved or constructed in the existing comparison module. Define the proper mate by the geometric scalar restriction square and the open mate by the open restriction square. Transposition of their composite agrees with transposition in two stages by the adjunction triangle identities; this is comparison_factorization. The finite ordinary direct images have identical section formulas, so finiteDirectImage_eq is equality of functors. The finite open adjunctions have identical right adjoints, giving finiteOpenIso by left-adjoint uniqueness. Whisker these isomorphisms to construct finiteImageIso. The finite reduction functors have the same scalar restriction right adjoint, giving finiteReductionIso. This node owns only these lower helpers, not the integral coefficient comparison or recorded realization theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem comparison_factorization {R S : Coefficients.{u}} (a : Change R S)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (K : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (R.ring X))) :
    (comparison a c).app K =
      (properComparison a c.g).app ((openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
        (proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage c.g (S.ring Y) (S.ring c.Z) (S.pull c.g)).map
          ((openComparison a c.i).app K)
